scope: DOCX main-document inventory section fragments after the adopted 0933 borrowed scanners; no production edits, builds, or captures were performed.

call_path.facts: The scanner computes the original source range, enforces section and input limits, creates the self-contained fragment, and then performs semantic/reference/tolerance accounting before reserving the descriptor and source span.
self_contained_fragment performs the required namespace injection and fallible fragment reservation/copy. The proposed parse reuse does not remove this copy or change original source offsets.

Section::from_xml_bytes first calls codec::validate, then footnote_columns::Snapshot::from_xml on a clone, and leaves semantic snapshot None. local_state later calls snapshot_mut, which invokes codec::decode and clones State; tolerance_report then clones the report.
validate runs parse_raw and discards Raw. decode runs parse_raw again, then decode_state, retaining Raw, State, and ToleranceReport in Snapshot.

Snapshot::from_xml converts the input to Vec, calls codec::read_with_context, then retains the bytes in Arc<[u8]>; inventory only uses the validation result, so that temporary snapshot and clone are immediately dropped.

read_with_context already accepts &[u8] and returns an owned Parsed result. It is currently behind the private footnote codec module; a crate-private wrapper is needed for the sibling inventory codec without changing the public Snapshot API.

order: codec::decode -> parse_raw -> decode_state -> retain temporary Section Snapshot
local_state and tolerance_report clone the values consumed by append_section
current_redundancy.independent_parser: The footnote-columns parser is a separate required validation pass; it must not be counted as a second section codec parse.

candidate.rank: deferred until the current 0934 profile attributes this path
candidate.mechanism: Add a crate-private inventory-only codec entry point that parses Raw once, invokes a crate-private footnote validation wrapper over read_with_context(&[u8], default Context), then runs decode_state on that same Raw and returns (State, ToleranceReport). Change append_section to consume those two values directly. Keep Section::from_xml_bytes and its lazy snapshot behavior unchanged.
candidate.smallest_seam: The helper belongs beside codec::validate/decode; no public Section constructor, public footnote API, source provider, or layout publication path needs to change. The footnote wrapper should return only validation success and must not retain an Arc or copied XML for this inventory-only call.
work_removed: the first parse_raw allocation and drop performed by codec::validate
the temporary Section/codec::Snapshot Raw retention and State clone used only to obtain inventory values
the temporary footnote Snapshot byte clone/Arc retention, while retaining its read_with_context validation
work_retained: self_contained_fragment namespace copy and its checked reservation
one section codec parse_raw plus one decode_state pass
all inventory descriptor, span, relationship, namespace, reference, limit, and tolerance bookkeeping

invariants_to_preserve: codec structural validation must occur before footnote-columns validation; semantic decode remains after both
public Section::from_xml_bytes remains eager for structural/footnote validation but lazy for semantic codec state, with unchanged error timing and unknown-markup round-trip behavior
append_section remains eager for inventory semantic decoding and receives the same State and ToleranceReport; tolerance contexts are mapped with the existing inserted namespace-byte adjustment
source spans and relationship/namespace bindings continue to reference the original document XML, not the injected fragment
reference-byte agreement, max_reference_bytes, max_section_bytes, max_sections, paragraph ownership/order, and fallible descriptor/span reservations remain in their current order
fresh source-backed/layout snapshots and publication/inverse paths remain untouched
risks_and_boundaries: The single Raw is live across footnote validation, whereas the current validation Raw is dropped before that pass. This can change transient peak overlap and allocation-failure timing even while typed parse-error precedence is unchanged; it requires focused failure/order and allocation evidence.

Calling read_with_context through a private wrapper deliberately skips only the inventory-unneeded footnote Snapshot byte retention. Do not redirect public footnote Snapshot construction or Section::from_xml_bytes to this path.
This candidate removes a duplicate section codec parse, not all XML work: footnote parsing, decode_state, namespace injection, and raw child copies remain.
No current 0934 profile percentage is inferred from 0932/0933 measurements; the live profile must establish whether this duplicate parse is material before implementation.
